headline: Maui County Cultural Resources Commission

meeting.summary: The commission was called to order at 11:10 a.m.
meeting.recap: The commission was called to order at 11:10 a.m.[[0:00:30]] Members chose a new chair with no objections.[[0:07:38]] Members voted in a vice chair by voice vote.[[0:09:43]] The County's lawyer trained members on the Sunshine Law, which covers open meetings.[[0:29:22]] The commission approved the Cox home plans by voice vote.[[1:23:44]] A parent urged the commission to approve the application.[[2:15:57]] Staff said the proposed special events do not fit the uses the commission can approve.[[2:42:57]] The applicant agreed to the delay.[[3:12:29]] Staff presented plans for a new home at 448 Front Street.[[3:40:10]] Staff presented a plan for a new parking lot at an elementary school built in 1904.[[4:00:55]]
decided: Members elected a commissioner as chair with no objections.
Members voted in a commissioner as vice chair by voice vote.
The commission approved the Cox home plans as recommended in the planning department's staff report.
meeting.next: The site visit was set from 9 to 11 o'clock on December 5, and the applicant said that time works. Staff said draft design guidelines for rebuilding must be reviewed before they come to the commission. Staff said a more detailed training on the preservation standards will be given at another time.
